area_rule: Class area sums shares.parquet area_m2 on cells with inside_aoi. The denominator is that classified area, not the Berlin boundary. Street and other unmapped land stays out of every class share. Effective cells equal area_m2 / 10000. Polygon counts come from block parts that intersect the boundary, once per schluessel.

n_typ_histogram_note: The v1 report field n_typ_histogram counts cells by how many typ values they contain. Its keys are mixture depth, not 06.08 typ codes, and this review does not use it as a class distribution.

recommendation.text: Proposal B is the working grouping for a later stratified description. It is not approved. Official 06.07 ststrnr remains the external reference. Published candidate B is not the working grouping: Wald (55), Park (53), Landwirtschaft (56), Brache (57), and Stadtplatz (54) each have area in 2024 and were pooled in vegetated_open. 1 of 12 comparison groups is under the pre-set floor of 1.0 km² or 50 effective cells: sealed_plaza. Groups under that floor stay in their pre-registered class and are not merged into a neighbour. Proposal C re-pools open land and is only a sensitivity. Water and construction stay exclusion categories. Public and special uses stay one heterogeneous bin. No thermal error entered this choice.
